extracted text: H-ITQ-13 is typically synthesized by the fluoride route in highly concentrated synthesis mixtures using hexamethonium hydroxide (HM(OH)2) as a structure directing agent (SDA). The synthesis mixture of ITQ-13(N) was prepared by dissolving GeO2 in HM(OH)2 aqueous solution, adding Al-isopropoxide dissolved in isopropanol, then adding TEOS dropwise. The mixture was heated to ~80°C until ethanol and excess water evaporated, then HF (40 wt% in water) was added. Small amounts of pure Si-ITQ-13 seed crystals were added. Crystallization occurred in a tumbling oven (vertical rotation) at 37 rpm for 14 days at 160°C. The product was washed with distilled water to pH near neutral, dried, and calcined in 50:50 N2 and O2 for 8 h (3 h heating from room temperature to 550°C and 5 h at 550°C). H-ITQ-13(P) followed the same procedure but with 10.7% less fluoride. Pure Si-ITQ-13 seeds were made by the same procedure excluding Ge and Al.
